product.name: Fernquill
product.tagline: Know what to sow this week.
product.description: Fernquill turns the seeds you have and the space you grow in into a plan for every week, then remembers what grew so next season starts from what worked.

heroImage.alt: A Fernquill weekly plan: sow broad beans, plant garlic, pick the last chard, and a note that two seed packets are past their best.

steps.title: Add your plot and your seeds
steps.text: Photograph the seed packets you already have and say where you grow: a balcony, a back garden or an allotment.

steps.title: Get a plan every Monday
steps.text: See what to sow, plant out and harvest this week, timed to the frost dates for your area.

steps.title: Log what grew
steps.text: Two taps after each harvest. Next spring, your plan starts from the varieties that did well.

features: A weekly sowing and harvest plan for your area
A seed stash that tracks packet dates
A season log with photos and notes
Works on your phone and your computer

faq.q: Why might a friend see a different price?
faq.a: We are still choosing the price, so visitors see one of a few planned prices. Your interest helps us decide.

faq.q: What happens to my email address?
faq.a: We use it only to tell you when Fernquill opens. The privacy notice says what we store and when we delete it.

privacy.jurisdictionNote: Fernquill is a fictional product used to show this kit. A real page names the country it operates from and the data protection authority you can complain to.
